raw_content: TBRD-04: Inbound / Outbound / Dashboard / Excel Integration
For the child_part received in the request data, check if a record is present in the part entity by comparing the short_part_number in part entity with the child_part.

Fetch all the rev_option_no from cu_wc_option_child entity for the child_part in the request data. For all the fetched rev_option_no, fetch all the engine_serial_num and build_date from cu_esn_bom_option_config by mapping rev_option_no with the option_assembly_num in cu_esn_bom_option_config entity.

Now fetch the maximum build_date from all the fetched engine_serial_num and extract year out of this maximum build_date. For the extracted year, fetch all the design_config_num and esn_count from cu_bom_config_vol entity by mapping with year attribute in cu_bom_config_vol entity.

From the fetched data, check the maximum esn_count and extract the associated design_config_num. For the short_part_number in the cu_part_segment entity perform update or insert the last_year_esn_produced by mapping with year and latest_configuration by mapping with design_config_num.
